name: South Tide's Run
summary: Along Silverpine Forest's southwestern edge, South Tide's Run meets the cold Great Sea. Its damp shore borders the forested interior and lies south of North Tide's Run.

sections.title: The Western Shore
sections.body: The Great Sea washes Silverpine Forest's southwestern shore. Inland, roads run east toward the Greymane Wall beneath the forest's cover. Along this open coast, the western tides meet a bleak stretch, largely untouched by inland settlements.

faq.q: Where is South Tide's Run located?
faq.answer: South Tide's Run follows Silverpine Forest's southwestern coast beside the open Great Sea.

faq.q: How does South Tide's Run differ from North Tide's Run?
aliases: north tides run vs south tides run
faq.answer: Both beaches follow Silverpine Forest's western shore. South Tide's Run lies on the southern coast, while North Tide's Run follows the northwest near Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Are there any settlements along South Tide's Run?
aliases: who lives in south tides run
faq.answer: No major towns or outposts line the beach. Most Forsaken activity stays inland near the main roads, leaving the shore isolated.

angles.text: As an Undead, you stand on a wild southwestern coast, far from the Sepulcher's protection. The Forsaken rarely tread this empty frontier.
